counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of an invagination or tooth-within-tooth appearance
no mention of tooth-shaped radiopacities or denticles
no isolated unerupted tooth without an associated radiopaque lesion
decisive_items: an unerupted lower left lateral incisor with an associated well-defined radiopaque lesion in the left mandibular anterior region, surrounded by a thin radiolucent halo, which appeared to obstruct the eruption path of the tooth.
surrounded by a thin radiolucent halo
response.rationale: C1 directly matches the full raw span linking the unerupted lower left lateral incisor to the radiopaque lesion with radiolucent halo and obstruction of eruption. R1 captures the lesion and halo but omits the obstructed tooth and complication. R2 relies on malalignment and unerupted tooth without the specific lesion, and R3 is only a descriptive consequence that ignores the causative radiopaque lesion.

rejected.why: Dens in dente is unsupported because the raw spans show malalignment and an unerupted tooth but not the invagination or tooth-within-tooth pattern; the radiopaque lesion with radiolucent halo is more specific for odontoma.
Impacted tooth is merely a descriptive consequence and does not account for the associated well-defined radiopaque lesion with thin radiolucent halo that provides the etiologic diagnosis.
